name: High Eden

known.via: English Wikipedia "High Eden" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

notes: Eden Valley Riesling often shows a characteristic lime note.

blurb.text: A subregion of Eden Valley, within the Barossa zone of South Australia, registered in 2001. Its main grapes are Riesling, Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz and Chardonnay, and the cool, windy climate and poor soils give low yields.
